forged_save.answer: narrowed the hole from two fields to one and disclosed the remainder honestly in w1-21-r2-forge.mjs R8, but closed neither the hole nor the report
forged_save.route: forge world.discovery.stood, the single field Discovery.RESTORE_READS trusts
forged_save.wire_format: zigzag-varint delta trail of cell indices, base64 - NOT the raw bitset the W1-MAP status file still describes
forged_save.delivered_precondition: critic-w1-map-r1 Afmt: one forged cell moves the model, so the A-results are not false negatives
instrument_blind_because: save/state.js keeps only .dropped from the restore audit; phantom_cells, missing_cells, stood_cells and legacy are computed and discarded
mapState() and getUIState().map publish no footprint field at all
map-probe L3 forges world.discovery.places, which RESTORE_READS deliberately excludes, so it cannot fail for the case that matters
none of map-probe's three --break self-tests touches the forgery path

biggest_gap.statement: Nothing in this build can tell an honest map from a completely forged one, because every compliance number it reports is derived from the model being audited. places_drawn == places_discovered reads green on a map showing 42 squares for a body that has walked nowhere - the verbatim failure mode the round-1 verdict recorded.
remedy: Publish the audit Discovery.restore() already computes: carry stood_cells, phantom_cells, missing_cells and legacy onto sim and out through mapState() and getUIState().map, instead of keeping only .dropped at save/state.js:674.
Repoint map-probe L3 at world.discovery.stood in the wire format (lift forgeTrail() from tools/harness/critic-w1-map-r1.mjs) and give it a --break forge self-test so it is proven able to go red.

Corroborate the footprint against engine.js:5468 this.travel.visited, an independently written record of the 25 m bins actually stood in - which is not a fixed point on one field, unlike the current design.
Secondary and cheap: Object.defineProperty(sim, 'discovery', {writable: false, configurable: false}) after construction.

provenance_warning: game/src/sim/discovery.js was rewritten at 23:32:58 on 2026-08-07 by the concurrently in-flight piece W1-21-r2 (still in_progress), after W1-MAP recorded itself complete. The footprint wire format changed from a raw bitset to a zigzag-varint delta trail. A forgery in the format the W1-MAP status file describes decodes to nothing and reads as a successful defence.
